maddeler.e:
استمطرن (form X)
# اِسْتَمْطَرْنَ (istamṭarna) /is.tam.tˤar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَمْطَرَ (istamṭara)
# اُسْتُمْطِرْنَ (ustumṭirna) /us.tum.tˤir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَمْطَرَ (istamṭara)
# اِسْتَمْطِرْنَ (istamṭirna) /is.tam.tˤir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَمْطَرَ (istamṭara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
